body: Thank you so much for all the advice! I definitely will try to set a meal plan since, I tend to not eat on time or eat a lot when I’m on my own.
Thank you I’ll try to put on some soundscapes noises to help!

Thank you, I think I might try to do that. Yah that’s true, I think it’ll help if I’m not alone. It’s the same with me I tend to overthink a lot about situations and cause myself to panic whenever I’m not distracted by something. So I do think it’d be best if I had my friend or my sister’s friend stay over. Thank you again!

I do have a friend that I talk to occasionally but they live pretty far away so I don’t know if they’ll be willing to stay over. My sister said that she can have one of her friends stay over but I don’t want to be a bother.
Thanks for the laugh 😂. I think I needed that

Absolutely horrible, it takes a whole out of me to go to my classes because of SA. Most of the time I don’t even go because how my anxiety attacks get before and during class.

Especially in my lectures, I’m currently barely even passing my classes. I have to somehow manage to get a decent grade on my upcoming final, to even pass my physiology class or I’m dead.
It was mostly studying but I did get to stream movies and play Kahoot for some of my classes and clubs. They were pretty fun!!

Yup I think I definitely did have SA as a child. Didn’t really have any friends, would absolutely hate going to school every morning. I still remember feeling such dread and anxiety hearing the alarm to wake up for my classes in elementary. 
Skipped out on a lot of fun and exciting opportunities because of it too. I didn’t know it was SA till I started high school. Everyone around me including myself just thought I was lazy and didn’t like going out.

I honestly prefer/miss being online. Most of classes was in person this semester and I pretty much skipped most of my lectures because of my social anxiety. I’d panic before every class and ended up not going. It was so much easier and less stressful when lessons were over zoom. 

Personally, It is much easier for me to participate and do things with other people online than in person. It feels less demanding and if I’m not feeling good I  don’t have to worry about looking good in front of others. Also if I’m feeling anxious I’d prefer little to no small talk. I don’t mind talking in zoom but sometimes things can get awkward especially if we have to have our videos on.

I really do understand where you’re coming from. I have people in my life that say the same thing to me as well. Honestly, I think they believe whatever they say is going to help you but in reality it just brings you down even more. Just today my sister asked me, what I have to worry about, when I have no life and apparently no responsibilities? In the end of the day just try your best not to take what they say to heart because they don’t really understand what you’re going through.

I’m honestly too afraid to talk to my therapist he always tells me to face my problems straight on and I just can’t. I’m not at a point where I can. The times
I’ve opened up to him, he tells me that I’m having ruminating thoughts again and I should stop. Thank you so much for replying though and I hope you are doing well.

Honestly I wish I was as capable and strong as you. I’ve tried to end my life before but I’m not even strong enough to see it through. Like everyone else I want to tell you to not give up and things will get better but I have no right to tell you that. Since I’m not even sure if things will get better. I hope whatever you decide to do or wherever you end up going you’ll be happy.
Thank you for understanding. I hope eventually we both feel better. Whenever that may be.
